intro.en: In the D.C. metro area, choosing where to live often comes down to school, work, and commute. With universities, government agencies, international organizations, research centers, and major employers spread across D.C., Maryland, and Northern Virginia, the right neighborhood can make everyday life much easier.
intro.zh: 在华盛顿都会区，选住哪里通常取决于学校、工作和通勤。大学、政府机构、国际组织、研究中心和大型雇主分布在特区、马里兰州和北弗吉尼亚，选对社区能让日常生活轻松许多。

text.en: A natural fit for students at GWU, Georgetown, American University, and Johns Hopkins SAIS, as well as professionals working around Downtown, the State Department, World Bank, IMF, consulting firms, think tanks, and international organizations. Areas like Foggy Bottom, Dupont Circle, Georgetown, and Tenleytown offer strong access to both campus and central D.C.
text.zh: 适合 GWU 的学生，以及在 Downtown DC、Foggy Bottom 和 West End 工作的职场人士。周边聚集了政府机构、国际组织、金融、法律及咨询公司，交通便利、生活配套丰富，适合希望住在城市核心区域、兼顾工作与生活的人。

short.en: A natural fit for GWU, Georgetown, AU, and SAIS students, and for professionals working Downtown. Foggy Bottom, Dupont Circle, and Georgetown keep campus and central D.C. close.
short.zh: 适合 GWU 的学生，以及在 Downtown DC、Foggy Bottom 和 West End 工作的职场人士。周边聚集了政府机构、国际组织、金融、法律及咨询公司，交通便利、生活配套丰富，适合希望住在城市核心区域、兼顾工作与生活的人。

text.en: A practical choice for Georgetown Law students and professionals working around Capitol Hill, federal agencies, law firms, government affairs, and Downtown D.C. NoMa and Navy Yard also offer newer apartment options and convenient access to major employment areas.
text.zh: 适合 Georgetown Law、Johns Hopkins SAIS 的学生，以及在 Capitol Hill、Union Station 和联邦机构工作的职场人士。NoMa 和 Navy Yard 拥有不少现代化公寓，周边餐饮、购物和休闲选择丰富，适合希望兼顾通勤便利与城市生活的人。

short.en: A practical choice for Georgetown Law students and those working around Capitol Hill and federal agencies. NoMa and Navy Yard add newer apartments.
short.zh: 适合 Georgetown Law、Johns Hopkins SAIS 的学生，以及在 Capitol Hill、Union Station 和联邦机构工作的职场人士。NoMa 和 Navy Yard 拥有不少现代化公寓，周边餐饮、购物和休闲选择丰富，适合希望兼顾通勤便利与城市生活的人。

text.en: The main housing market for University of Maryland students, especially around College Park, Greenbelt, and Hyattsville. The area is well connected to campus by walking, shuttle, and Metro, and is especially popular with students looking for shared housing and more budget friendly options.
text.zh: 适合 UMD 的学生，以及希望住在校园周边的年轻职场人士。College Park 拥有丰富的学生公寓和合租选择，周边生活配套完善，部分社区可通过 Metro 或校车往返校园，适合希望兼顾通勤与租房预算的人。

short.en: The main housing market for University of Maryland students. Well connected to campus by walking, shuttle, and Metro, with plenty of budget-friendly shared housing.
short.zh: 适合 UMD 的学生，以及希望住在校园周边的年轻职场人士。College Park 拥有丰富的学生公寓和合租选择，周边生活配套完善，部分社区可通过 Metro 或校车往返校园，适合希望兼顾通勤与租房预算的人。

text.en: A strong option for professionals working around NIH, healthcare, research, biotech, and the I-270 life sciences corridor, as well as renters who want easy Red Line access into D.C. Bethesda, North Bethesda, and Rockville offer a mix of newer apartments, residential neighborhoods, and access to major employment centers.
text.zh: 适合在 NIH、医疗机构及 I-270 生命科学走廊工作的科研、生物科技和医疗行业人士。Bethesda、North Bethesda 和 Rockville 拥有成熟的生活配套与多样的住宅选择，部分区域可搭乘 Red Line 前往 Downtown DC，适合希望兼顾工作便利与生活品质的人。

short.en: A strong option for professionals in healthcare, research, and biotech, with easy Red Line access into D.C. Bethesda, North Bethesda, and Rockville offer newer apartments.
short.zh: 适合在 NIH、医疗机构及 I-270 生命科学走廊工作的科研、生物科技和医疗行业人士。Bethesda、North Bethesda 和 Rockville 拥有成熟的生活配套与多样的住宅选择，部分区域可搭乘 Red Line 前往 Downtown DC，适合希望兼顾工作便利与生活品质的人。

text.en: Popular with professionals working at Amazon HQ2, the Pentagon, consulting firms, defense companies, and major tech employers, as well as people commuting into D.C. Areas like Rosslyn, Clarendon, Pentagon City, National Landing, Tysons, and Reston offer a mix of Metro access, newer apartments, and proximity to Northern Virginia’s major employment hubs.
text.zh: 适合在 Amazon HQ2、Pentagon、咨询公司及科技企业工作的职场人士，以及需要经常往返 Washington, DC 的租客。Rosslyn、Courthouse、Ballston、Crystal City 和 Pentagon City 等社区拥有便利的交通、现代化公寓和丰富的生活配套，适合希望缩短通勤时间、享受都市生活的人。

short.en: Popular with professionals at Amazon HQ2, the Pentagon, and major tech and consulting firms. Rosslyn, Clarendon, and Tysons offer Metro access and newer apartments.
short.zh: 适合在 Amazon HQ2、Pentagon、咨询公司及科技企业工作的职场人士，以及需要经常往返 Washington, DC 的租客。Rosslyn、Courthouse、Ballston、Crystal City 和 Pentagon City 等社区拥有便利的交通、现代化公寓和丰富的生活配套，适合希望缩短通勤时间、享受都市生活的人。

text.en: Once you know which area fits your school, office, and daily routine, we can help with apartment search, leasing, moving, furniture, room dividers, Wi Fi, electricity, renters insurance, and other move in essentials.
text.zh: 选好适合你的学校、公司和日常作息的区域后，我们可以帮你搞定找房、签约、搬家、家具、房间隔断、Wi-Fi、水电、租客保险等入住必备事项。

short.en: Once you know your area, we can help with the rest, from apartment search to move-in essentials.
short.zh: 选好区域后，其余的交给我们，从找房到入住所需的一切。

desc.en: Historic brick rowhouses, M Street shopping and the C&O Canal next to Georgetown University. Charming and safe, but no Metro station and rents are high.
desc.zh: 历史红砖排屋、M街购物和C&O运河，紧邻乔治城大学；迷人安全，但没有地铁站，租金偏高。

credits.author: Warren LeMay from Cincinnati, OH, United States
Warren LeMay from Cincinnati, OH, United States

desc.en: Lively circle of rowhouses, embassies, bookstores and cafés on the Red Line. Very walkable and social, popular with young professionals and GWU/Georgetown students.
desc.zh: 排屋、使馆、书店和咖啡馆环绕的热闹街区，红线地铁直达；步行便利、社交氛围好，年轻上班族和GWU/乔治城学生多。

desc.en: Home to GWU, the State Department and the Kennedy Center, with its own Metro stop. Convenient for GW students; quieter at night, mid-to-high rents.
desc.zh: 乔治华盛顿大学、国务院和肯尼迪中心所在地，自带地铁站；GW学生通勤方便，夜间较安静，租金中高。

desc.en: Victorian rowhouses around a leafy circle, steps from 14th Street's restaurants and bars. Stylish and walkable, popular with young professionals; rents are high.
desc.zh: 绿树环岛周围的维多利亚式排屋，紧邻14街的餐厅和酒吧；时尚、步行友好，年轻上班族喜爱，租金较高。

credits.author: Ted Eytan from Washington, DC, USA

desc.en: Fast-changing area near Howard University and U Street with music venues, bars and new apartments. Green/Yellow lines; energetic and a bit cheaper than Logan Circle.
desc.zh: 靠近霍华德大学和U街，音乐场馆、酒吧和新公寓不断涌现，有绿/黄线地铁；氛围活跃，租金略低于Logan Circle。

desc.en: New high-rise rentals north of Union Station near Gallaudet and Union Market. Red Line and Amtrak make commuting easy; modern but still filling in.
desc.zh: 联合车站以北新建高层公寓区，靠近加劳德特大学和Union Market；红线和Amtrak通勤便利，现代化但仍在发展中。

desc.en: Tree-lined rowhouse streets around the Capitol and Eastern Market. Calm, with a real community feel and many Hill staffers; Blue/Orange/Silver lines.
desc.zh: 国会大厦和东方市场周边，林荫街道和排屋，社区感强、氛围安静，国会工作人员多；蓝/橙/银线地铁。

desc.en: Riverfront district of new apartment towers, Nationals Park and Yards Park. Modern amenities on the Green Line; lively on game days, mid-to-high rents.
desc.zh: 河滨新区，新建公寓楼、国民公园球场和Yards Park；设施现代，有绿线地铁，比赛日很热闹，租金中高。

desc.en: Consulting, law, corporate offices and associations; close to Logan Circle and Dupont.
desc.zh: 咨询、法律、企业办公和行业协会集中，靠近Logan Circle和杜邦环岛。

desc.en: Lobbying, law, public affairs and consulting; near Dupont, Logan Circle and Foggy Bottom.
desc.zh: 游说、法律、公共事务和咨询机构集中，靠近杜邦环岛、Logan Circle和雾谷。

name.zh: 宾夕法尼亚区 / 唐人街

desc.en: Law, associations, media and hospitality; near Downtown and Mt Vernon Triangle.
desc.zh: 法律、行业协会、传媒和酒店业集中，靠近市中心和Mt Vernon Triangle。

desc.en: State Department, World Bank, IMF, healthcare and GWU; near the West End and Georgetown.
desc.zh: 美国国务院、世界银行、IMF、医疗机构和GWU所在地，靠近West End和乔治城。

desc.en: Congress, government and policy work; near Navy Yard and NoMa.
desc.zh: 国会、政府和政策机构集中，靠近Navy Yard和NoMa。

desc.en: Government agencies, tech, nonprofits and offices; near Union Market.
desc.zh: 政府机构、科技公司、非营利组织和写字楼集中，靠近Union Market。

desc.en: Federal agencies, defense-related firms and new offices; near Capitol Hill.
desc.zh: 联邦机构、国防相关企业和新写字楼集中，靠近国会山。

desc.en: Consulting, defense and corporate HQs across the river in Arlington; near Courthouse and Clarendon.
desc.zh: 河对岸阿灵顿的咨询、国防和企业总部集中地，靠近Courthouse和Clarendon。

name.zh: 水晶城 / 国家登陆区

desc.en: Defense, government contractors and Amazon HQ2; near Pentagon City.
desc.zh: 国防、政府承包商和亚马逊第二总部所在地，靠近Pentagon City。

desc.en: Biotech, healthcare and consulting, home to NIH; near Chevy Chase.
desc.zh: 生物科技、医疗和咨询集中，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）所在地，靠近Chevy Chase。

credits.author: John Brighenti from Rockville, MD, United States

desc.en: Jesuit university famed for international affairs and law, crowned by Gothic Healy Hall. Georgetown has historic row houses and riverfront shops but no Metro stop; shuttles fill the gap.
desc.zh: 以国际关系和法学闻名的耶稣会大学，哥特式的希利楼是其标志。乔治城遍布历史排屋和滨河商店，但没有地铁站，需靠校车接驳。

desc.en: Urban campus blocks from the White House, strong in policy, international affairs and media. Foggy Bottom is central and walkable with its own Metro stop, though rents run high.
desc.zh: 距白宫仅几个街区的城市校园，公共政策、国际事务与传媒专业实力强。雾谷地段居中、步行便利，有专属地铁站，但租金偏高。

desc.en: Known for international service, public affairs and its arboretum-like campus. Surrounding Spring Valley and Tenleytown are quiet and upscale; a free shuttle links to the Red Line.
desc.zh: 以国际服务和公共事务专业著称，校园如植物园般葱郁。周边春谷和坦利敦安静高档，免费校车连接地铁红线。

desc.en: Leading historically Black university, with Founders Library anchoring The Yard. Nearby Shaw and U Street offer rowhouse rentals, nightlife and two Metro lines.
desc.zh: 顶尖的历史性黑人大学，创始人图书馆矗立于中心草坪The Yard。邻近的肖区和U街有大量排屋出租，夜生活丰富，并有两条地铁线。

area.zh: 华盛顿特区勒德罗伊特公园 / 肖区

desc.en: The U.S. Catholic bishops' national university, next to the vast Basilica of the National Shrine. Brookland is a calm, leafy area with an arts walk and its own Red Line station.
desc.zh: 美国天主教主教团创办的全国性大学，毗邻宏伟的国家圣母无染原罪始胎朝圣地大教堂。布鲁克兰安静多树，有艺术长廊和地铁红线站。

area.zh: 华盛顿特区东北布鲁克兰

desc.en: The world's leading university for deaf and hard-of-hearing students, with Victorian Gothic halls. It borders fast-growing NoMa and Union Market, with new apartments and the Red Line.
desc.zh: 全球领先的聋人及听障学生大学，校内多维多利亚哥特式建筑。紧邻快速发展的NoMa与联合市场，新公寓林立，可乘地铁红线。

area.zh: 华盛顿特区东北近郊 / NoMa

desc.en: Virginia's largest public university, known for economics, law and cybersecurity. The Fairfax campus is suburban and car-friendly; apartments are plentiful and buses reach the Orange Line.
desc.zh: 弗吉尼亚州规模最大的公立大学，经济学、法学和网络安全专业知名。费尔法克斯校区属郊区、开车方便，公寓选择多，有巴士连接地铁橙线。

area.zh: 弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯

hub.zh: 阿灵顿 / 费尔法克斯

desc.en: Maryland's flagship, strong in computer science, engineering and business, with Georgian red-brick halls. College Park is a classic college town with new apartments and a Green Line stop.
desc.zh: 马里兰州旗舰公立大学，计算机、工程和商科实力强，校园以乔治亚式红砖建筑为主。大学公园市是典型大学城，新公寓多，有地铁绿线站。

desc.en: Seat of Congress atop Capitol Hill; free guided tours start at the underground Visitor Center, and the surrounding rowhouse blocks are popular rentals.
desc.zh: 美国国会所在地，免费导览从地下游客中心出发；周边联排别墅街区是热门租房区域。

desc.en: Neoclassical memorial at the west end of the National Mall overlooking the Reflecting Pool—beautiful at sunrise and open 24/7.
desc.zh: 位于国家广场西端的新古典主义纪念堂，俯瞰倒影池，全天开放，日出时尤其美。

places.address: 2 Lincoln Memorial Cir NW, Washington, DC 20037

desc.en: The 555-foot obelisk at the center of the Mall, with an elevator to an observation level; timed tickets are released online.
desc.zh: 国家广场中心高约169米的方尖碑，可乘电梯上观景层，需提前在网上预约限时门票。

desc.en: The President's home and office on Pennsylvania Avenue, best viewed from Lafayette Square to the north or the Ellipse to the south.
desc.zh: 位于宾夕法尼亚大道的总统官邸和办公地，北面的拉法叶广场和南面的椭圆草坪是最佳观赏位置。

name.en: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
name.zh: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

desc.en: Free Smithsonian museum on the Mall famous for its rotunda elephant, dinosaur hall and the Hope Diamond.
desc.zh: 国家广场上的免费史密森尼博物馆，以圆厅大象、恐龙厅和“希望钻石”闻名。

places.address: 10th St & Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20560

desc.en: Riverside park along the Potomac with fountains, lawns and kayak rentals, next to the restaurants of Washington Harbour.
desc.zh: 沿波托马克河的滨水公园，有喷泉、草坪和皮划艇租赁，紧邻华盛顿港的餐厅区。

desc.en: Beaux-Arts rail hub for Amtrak, MARC, VRE and the Metro Red Line, steps from the Capitol and the NoMa apartment district.
desc.zh: 布杂艺术风格的交通枢纽，汇集美铁、MARC、VRE通勤铁路和地铁红线，步行可达国会和NoMa公寓区。

desc.en: Mile-long waterfront district on the Washington Channel with restaurants, music venues, piers and new apartments.
desc.zh: 沿华盛顿海峡约一英里长的滨水街区，餐厅、音乐场馆、码头和新建公寓林立。

desc.en: The ornate Thomas Jefferson Building, the world's largest library, with its domed Main Reading Room; free to visit.
desc.zh: 华丽的托马斯·杰斐逊大楼是全球最大图书馆的主馆，圆顶主阅览室闻名，免费参观。

desc.en: Home of the Washington Nationals on the Anacostia riverfront, the centerpiece of the fast-growing Navy Yard neighborhood.
desc.zh: 华盛顿国民队主场，位于阿纳科斯蒂亚河畔，是快速发展的海军船坞街区的核心。

places.address: 1500 S Capitol St SE, Washington, DC 20003

credits.author: All-Pro Reels from District of Columbia, USA

desc.en: Amazon's second headquarters at Metropolitan Park in National Landing: two office towers plus a public park and retail, near Pentagon City Metro.
desc.zh: 亚马逊第二总部，位于国家登陆区的大都会公园，包括两栋办公楼、公共公园和商铺，靠近五角大楼城地铁站。

desc.en: Headquarters of the World Bank Group, the international development lender, a large employer of economists and analysts two blocks from the White House.
desc.zh: 国际发展贷款机构世界银行集团的总部，大量雇用经济学家和分析师，距白宫仅两个街区。

desc.en: Headquarters of the International Monetary Fund, which oversees global monetary cooperation; its HQ1 and HQ2 buildings face each other on 19th St.
desc.zh: 负责全球货币合作的国际货币基金组织总部，HQ1与HQ2两栋大楼在19街相对而立。

desc.en: The Washington Post's newsroom and offices at One Franklin Square on K Street, overlooking Franklin Park.
desc.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》位于K街富兰克林广场一号的编辑部和办公室，俯瞰富兰克林公园。

desc.en: National Public Radio's headquarters and broadcast studios in NoMa, a short walk from Union Station.
desc.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台（NPR）总部及播音室，位于NoMa，步行可达联合车站。

places.address: 1111 North Capitol St NE, Washington, DC 20002

desc.en: National Geographic's headquarters campus at 17th and M Streets, home to the Society and its public museum.
desc.zh: 国家地理位于17街与M街交口的总部园区，国家地理学会及其对外开放的博物馆都在这里。

desc.en: Headquarters of the Inter-American Development Bank, the main development lender for Latin America and the Caribbean, near Metro Center.
desc.zh: 美洲开发银行总部，拉美和加勒比地区最主要的发展贷款机构，靠近Metro Center地铁站。

places.address: 1300 New York Ave NW, Washington, DC 20577

desc.en: George Washington University's teaching hospital in Foggy Bottom, right next to the Foggy Bottom–GWU Metro station.
desc.zh: 乔治·华盛顿大学的教学医院，位于雾谷，紧邻Foggy Bottom–GWU地铁站。
